title: A countdown
description:
Count down with timers and promises.

```
3
2
1
Lift off!
```
hints: `new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, ms))` is the whole of `sleep` (lesson 4.02).
A plain `for` loop with `await sleep(100)` inside waits between numbers.
requirements: `sleep(ms)` returns a promise that resolves after `ms` milliseconds.
`countdown(from)` is an `async` function that prints each number one per 100 ms and then `Lift off!`.
stretch: Accept an `AbortSignal` so another part of the program can cancel the countdown.
